groups.restriction: On a MIRROR surface, points-per-possession and opponent points-per-possession are the same quantity up to seeded noise (measured max separation in V3: 0.00348). Offence and defence claims must therefore be scored on VS_ERA_REFERENCE and REFERENCE_VS_TEAM respectively — different games, independent counterparties.
Shares of one possession total. A fixture may claim ABOVE on at most three of these simultaneously; more is compositionally self-defeating.
Three-point and interior shares trade off against each other (midrange takes the remainder). A fixture may not claim ABOVE on both threeShare and interiorShotShare.
Both teams in a game share its pace. Pace is attributed to the subject only against the frozen reference, compared with the reference's self-baseline; A-vs-B pace attributes to neither side.
Rebound rates are contests, so each needs the frozen reference on the other side of the contest.
Top-share and share entropy are functions of the same distribution; only topScoringShare exists in the catalogue, and no eligible trait claims it.
